errors.text_span: „Full FT“ е най-високият стълб (приблизително в ниските 70 GB)
errors.evidence: The bar for "Full FT" is significantly higher than 70 GB, reaching approximately 75 GB. Describing it as "in the low 70s GB" is an underestimation.
The bar for "MTL-FT" is visibly just below the 40 GB line, at approximately 39 GB. Stating it is "around 40 GB" is imprecise as it does not capture that the value is less than 40.

The description correctly notes that the "Ours" category is highlighted with a green bar, but it omits the fact that the corresponding label on the x-axis is also written in a bold font for additional emphasis.
The description does not mention that the x-axis label for "Ours" is in a bold typeface, which serves as a form of visual emphasis in addition to the bar's color.
